title: Post-apocalyptic game with AI arts, what do you think of it?
author: ToprogressOnTwitch

comments.author: ToprogressOnTwitch
comments.body:
**All the graphics have been done with AI, except for the paper background.**  
**I am looking forward to read your comments!** 

Context:  
Organized Survival is a base-management survival game with a UI optimized for mobile.

The player explores a post-apocalyptic world with up to five characters.  
The goal is to find resources to build defense in the Camp and survive the attack of the Aliens each night.

Organized Survival will be release as a single-player version in the first place, then a multiplayer version will be developed.

Thanks for reading!

comments.author: StrictTyping648
comments.body: It looks like a mobile game tbh OP

replies.author: ToprogressOnTwitch
replies.body: Thank you for your feedback! It will indeed be a mobile game.

replies.author: StrictTyping648
replies.body: Ah gotcha you might have better luck on r/MobileGameDev then

replies.author: ToprogressOnTwitch
replies.body: Thank you for your advice! To be honest I have never thought about visiting this Reddit.

comments.author: sirpalee
comments.body: Looks ok for a mobile game. Some of the icons are inconsistent tho. Like having some roman helmet, or an alien face here and there.

replies.author: ToprogressOnTwitch
replies.body:
Thank you for your feedback!  
The game is still in its Beta state. The details will be improved over time.  
Did you notice anything else that looks inconsistent?

replies.author: sirpalee
replies.body: Can't say much without knowing more of what the game does. Just try to apply common sense here, if the game is themed as a zombie - apocalypse - survival then try avoiding any icons that does not make sense in that context. Etc.

replies.author: ToprogressOnTwitch
replies.body:
Thank you for developing your thoughts, I greatly appreciate it.  
I will do my best to clear out the inconsistencies in my UI for the final version.

replies.author: ToprogressOnTwitch
replies.body:
Thank you for your feedback.  
What is the main thing you dislike?

replies.author: AffectionateArm9636
replies.body: I think the icons and buttons are unnecessarily big and maximalist. Personally I would have a better experience if everything was more minimalist. There isn’t a reason why “treasures” should have that giant lock for example. It makes the menu look extremely cluttered.

replies.author: ToprogressOnTwitch
replies.body:
Thank you for developing your thoughts, I greatly appreciate it.  
I completely understand your point of view and I have already received similar feedback.  
To be honest, I designed a maximalist UI on purpose, as I find it more immersive.  
I understand that it is not the opinion of everyone, but I hope I will do a work good enough to make my game pleasant even for people that prefer minimalist UI.

replies.author: ToprogressOnTwitch
replies.body:
Thank you for your feedback!  
It is my game indeed and I am glad you appreciate its graphics.  
Right now I am coding all the features of Organized Survival. I will keep posting my progression on Reddit regularly.

comments.author: Zeryphanthes
comments.body:
I am going to be honest, this looks like almost every other mobile game with a post apocalyptic theme on the market, and that is a bad thing. I see nothing here that would grab my attention and make me go, Yeah I want to play this game over the hundreds of others I am scrolling through.

You are already fighting an uphill battle using AI, so you really are going to want and need to stylize this more.

replies.author: ToprogressOnTwitch
replies.body:
Thank you a lot for your honest feedback!

I have noted that my graphics are too generic, and you confirm my thoughts.  
Fortunately, it is still the Beta and I will personalize the graphics more for the final version.

Thank you again for your feedback, it is very precious to me 🤍
